description: Source code for the FeatureService class in OrchardCore, managing features such as retrieval, enabling, disabling, and toggling features within the OrchardCore CMS framework.

classes.name: FeatureService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to manage features in OrchardCore, including retrieval, enabling, disabling, and toggling features.

methods.name: GetAvailableFeatures
methods.description: Retrieves all available features excluding themes.

methods.name: GetAvailableFeature
methods.description: Retrieves a specific available feature by its ID.

methods.name: GetAvailableFeatures (overload)
methods.description: Retrieves available features matching a list of IDs.

methods.name: GetModuleFeaturesAsync
methods.description: Gets detailed module features including their enabled status and dependencies.

methods.name: EnableOrDisableFeaturesAsync
methods.description: Enables, disables, or toggles a set of features based on the specified action.
